faq.q: What is the origin of Sana?
faq.a: Sana is associated with Arabic. Sana is Arabic سَنَا (Sanā), meaning 'radiance, brilliance'.
Yes — the underlying form سَنَا is Arabic.
Sana can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Sana should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Sanā is not a Quranic personal name.
